title: Sugar, spice, and sticky rice
slide_intent: Demonstrate how a type hierarchy helps a reader move from a recipe category to an invitation to explore and then to supporting information.
strategic_value: Instacart can give an editorial recipe feature a distinct display voice while keeping the surrounding service copy easy to scan.
demonstration: A dark green feature pairs a left-aligned stack of wordmark, eyebrow, headline, subhead and copy with a large food photograph at right. Fine print sits near the bottom.
practical_value: Use the recipe composition to check whether the display phrase gets the first read and whether the explanatory and legal copy remain separate.

content_islands.name: Editorial type stack
content_islands.spec: Place the wordmark above the recipe eyebrow. Set the display headline in two lines with the subhead and supporting copy directly below.

content_islands.name: Food photograph and footer
content_islands.spec: Align a large rounded image with the right side of the green panel, keeping the small legal text at its lower left.
